name: Super Bowl
motifNote: Generic look built on the NFL shield navy/red with the sterling-silver tone of the standardized (since Super Bowl XLV/L) trophy-centric mark; confetti fall is the universal post-game visual and is not a protected mark.

name: Super Bowl XX
motifNote: Super Bowl XX (Bears 46, Patriots 10, New Orleans) logo is navy with a magenta/berry accent and pale silver; thin speed-stripe treatment echoes 1980s NFL graphics. Hexes are the literal fills in the vector logo file.

name: Super Bowl LI
motifNote: Houston edition of the templated silver mark with a red reflection and dark maroon shadow (sportslogos notes LI started the red/blue reflection era); a lone star nods to Texas without using the logo.

name: Super Bowl LII
motifNote: Minneapolis edition: midnight navy with an icy cyan reflection on silver numerals (winter-city cue). Hexes are literal fills in the vector logo file.

name: Super Bowl LIII
motifNote: Atlanta edition: deep navy and royal blue reflection on silver numerals. Hexes are fills in the vector logo file.

name: Super Bowl LIV
motifNote: Miami edition: 'Super Bowl' wordmark sat on a teal/aqua bar (Dolphins nod) and the trophy reflection turned gold for the first time since LI. Exact hexes not published; teal and gold are approximations of the described colors.

name: Super Bowl LV
motifNote: Tampa edition: silver numerals with aqua/teal shading and an orange ('creamsicle') bar, plus a dark maroon shadow (#5D0024) in the file. Values sampled from the vector logo.

name: Super Bowl LVI
motifNote: Los Angeles edition: red Roman numerals (#EE3440 / deep #A01C31) over a cream-to-peach sunset gradient (#F6DFA4 -> #F7996A) with slate palms. Use horizontal sunset bands, never palms+numerals together (that is the logo). Hexes are fills in the vector logo.

name: Super Bowl LVII
motifNote: Glendale/Arizona edition: canyon window in purple and red with turquoise light beams referencing the Arizona flag starburst; radiating chevrons evoke the beams without the mark.

name: Super Bowl LVIII
motifNote: Las Vegas edition: purple-to-red sunset behind the Strip and the 'Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas' sign; small marquee stars nod to the sign without reproducing it. Hexes are literal fills in the vector logo.

name: Super Bowl LIX
motifNote: New Orleans edition: logo hand-beaded by Black Masking Indian artist Tahj Williams in burgundy, red, light green and cream. A diamond/harlequin bead grid echoes Mardi Gras beadwork without the mark. Values sampled from the raster layer of the logo file.

name: Super Bowl LX
motifNote: Bay Area (Santa Clara) edition: rainbow logo with red, yellow, green, blue, pink and white; Golden Gate Bridge, trees and skyline drawn into the 'LX'. Sampled from the vector logo: hot pink, cyan, plum, sage-teal (#5FA096) and pale yellow. Multicolor confetti carries the palette without bridge/skyline imagery.

name: FIFA World Cup USA 1994
motifNote: Pentagram's emblem: blue ball flying over the red stripes of a waving US flag; red/white waving stripes are the transferable cue.

name: FIFA World Cup France 1998
motifNote: Ball rising like a sun over the pitch in French tricolore blue/red with a warm yellow; tricolore bands are a safe cue.

name: FIFA World Cup Korea/Japan 2002
motifNote: Swirling multicolor emblem (red, blue, green, yellow, cafe-au-lait gold) for the first co-hosted, first Asian World Cup; loose color flecks rather than the swirl.

name: FIFA World Cup Germany 2006
motifNote: The 'smiling faces' emblem built from bright dots of yellow, red, orange, blue and green on white; dot/confetti scatter mirrors its playful identity.

name: FIFA World Cup South Africa 2010
motifNote: Rock-art-inspired figure in blue, green, red and tangerine; African geometric/chevron patterning is a common non-logo cue of the look.

name: FIFA World Cup Brazil 2014
motifNote: 'Inspiration' emblem of three hands forming the trophy in Brazilian green, yellow and midnight blue with orange/red accents; tropical color flecks, not hands.

name: FIFA World Cup Russia 2018
motifNote: Red/gold/blue identity drawing on Russian icon painting, folk ornament and space-age heritage; fine ornamental engraving-style linework fits the look.

name: FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022
motifNote: Maroon (Qatari flag) with blue and yellow; the emblem echoes a woolen shawl and the flag's nine-point serrated edge, so a zig-zag chevron band is on-brand.

name: FIFA World Cup Canada/Mexico/USA 2026
motifNote: Core identity is deliberately black/white with the gold trophy, while each host city adds its own palette; keep it monochrome+gold and let host-city colors be data-driven. Gold hex is approximate (no public spec).

name: UEFA Euro 2016
motifNote: Brandia Central's logo blends French tricolore red, white and blue in flowing lines around the trophy; tricolore ribbons are the cue. Hexes are fills in the vector logo.

name: UEFA Euro 2020 (played 2021)
motifNote: Pan-European 'Building Bridges' identity in teal/cyan with a gold-sand accent; overlapping arcs (bridges) suit it. Played June-July 2021 but branded 2020.

name: UEFA Euro 2024
motifNote: 24 multicolor stripes radiating from behind the trophy, grouped by the colors of UEFA's 55 member flags; radiating flag-color stripes are the signature non-logo cue. Other stripe colors in the file: #00AB54 green, #0D4D8E, #6098C1, #C6D8E3.

name: Copa America Centenario
motifNote: 100th-anniversary badge: gradient-gold trophy and lettering with blue, red and green sweeping curves. Hexes approximate; no published spec.

name: Copa America 2019
motifNote: Built from the Brazilian flag colors with fans celebrating around the trophy; green/yellow/blue celebration flecks. Hexes from the vector logo and logotyp.us.

name: Copa America 2021
motifNote: Navy-led logo with yellow, sky blue, red and green accents (originally Argentina/Colombia, moved to Brazil). Hexes are literal fills in the vector logo.

name: Copa America 2024
motifNote: CONMEBOL said the identity draws on host-nation symbols: blue, red and white with stars and stripes behind the trophy; stars are the cleanest cue.

name: World Series
motifNote: MLB navy/red with the gold of the Commissioner's Trophy flags; red-white-blue fan bunting on the rails is the classic Fall Classic cue and is not a mark.

name: NBA Finals
motifNote: Since 2022 the Finals script returned in black and gold to complement the Larry O'Brien Trophy; NBA blue as secondary. Gold sampled from the 2022 Finals vector logo.

name: WNBA Finals
motifNote: WNBA identity is built on its 'happy orange' with an oatmeal/cream neutral; orange sampled from the WNBA Finals logo file.

name: Stanley Cup Final
motifNote: Black/silver NHL palette; the Cup's engraved bands of champions' names are the iconic, non-logo texture.

name: MLS Cup
motifNote: MLS Cup mark is black with an icy silver and a gold trophy tone; hexes are fills in the vector logo file.

name: Grey Cup
motifNote: Templated (since 2023) Grey Cup mark: silver trophy, CFL red/black, with a host-city scene that changes yearly; red/black plus silver is the stable core. Hexes approximate (CFL red from logotyp).

name: College Football Playoff
motifNote: Near-black and gold CFP identity; the mark's football-shaped stripes suggest simple diagonal stripes. Hexes match the CFP vector logo fills.

name: College Football Playoff National Championship
motifNote: Same black/gold system as the CFP; the trophy is gold, bronze and stainless steel, so a bronze secondary is apt.

name: NCAA Men's Final Four
motifNote: March Madness identity is black with NCAA blue (PMS 2925); host-city Final Four logos change yearly but always keep the NCAA blue disc.

name: NCAA Women's Final Four
motifNote: Since 2022 the women's tournament shares the March Madness brand (black + NCAA blue).

name: Rose Bowl Game
motifNote: Rose red and green (brandcolorcode lists #E2231A rose red / #007934 stem green; the logo file uses #ED1C2E, #008348/#036534 and a #007AC2 blue); a rose-garland/laurel wreath evokes the Tournament of Roses floral tradition.

name: Sugar Bowl
motifNote: Navy with gold and red; hexes are fills in the vector logo.

name: Orange Bowl
motifNote: Navy field with orange, golden yellow and leaf green (#4DBD38) citrus accents; hexes are fills in the vector logo.

name: Cotton Bowl Classic
motifNote: Navy, royal blue and gold; a Texas lone-star cue. Hexes are fills in the vector logo.

name: Peach Bowl
motifNote: Navy and blue with red accent; hexes are fills in the vector logo.

name: Fiesta Bowl
motifNote: Fiesta red, orange and yellow (#FFD100) celebration palette on navy; hexes are fills in the vector logos.

name: UEFA Champions League Final
motifNote: Deep navy with silver; the starball's star pattern is the competition's signature texture (a plain scattered star field is fine, the eight-star ball itself is the logo).

name: UEFA Europa League Final
motifNote: Black and orange identity (kept through the 2024 refresh) with an orange 'energy wave'; flowing orange stripes are on-brand.

name: CONMEBOL Libertadores Final
motifNote: Brand manual: official backgrounds are black and white; gold (Pantone 873 C) is the symbol color for 'Gloria Eterna'; a red full-stop accent appears in campaign type. Vertical gold arcs/stripes echo the symbol's rising form.

name: MLB All-Star Game
motifNote: Logo changes every year with the host club; generic MLB navy/red with a star field. Override per host if desired.

name: NBA All-Star Game
motifNote: Host-specific logo every year; generic NBA blue/red with stars.

name: NHL All-Star Game
motifNote: Host-specific logo every year; generic NHL black/silver with stars.

name: MLB Postseason
motifNote: October baseball = bunting on the rails plus MLB navy/red.

name: NFL Playoffs
motifNote: NFL navy with the playoff mark's red and silver; forward-pointing chevrons suggest advancement.

name: NBA Playoffs
motifNote: NBA Playoffs mark is NBA blue (2018 playoffs logo fill #1A428A) with red; gold hints toward the Finals trophy.

name: Stanley Cup Playoffs
motifNote: Black/silver NHL playoff look; engraved-band texture referencing the Cup.
